brief: 5 healthy client boundaries every freelancer should set — and how to communicate them.

slots.subtitle: Five essential limits to protect your time, your creativity, and your income—without sacrificing client relationships.
slots.author: Studio Solenne
Studio Solenne
slots.body: Clear expectations prevent resentment and scope creep. When you honor your own time, clients learn to mirror that respect back.

slots.author: Studio Solenne
slots.body: Decide when you’re available and stick to it. Turn off notifications after hours so clients learn urgency is not importance.

slots.author: Studio Solenne
slots.body: You are not on retainer for instant replies. A 24-hour weekday window is reasonable, professional, and protects your deep work.

slots.author: Studio Solenne
slots.body: Scope creep quietly steals your profit. Reference your contract kindly but firmly when requests drift beyond the original agreement.

slots.author: Studio Solenne
slots.body: Money boundaries are business boundaries. Require deposits, outline late fees, and pause work when invoices pass their due date.

slots.author: Studio Solenne
slots.body: Unlimited rounds drain creativity and calendar space. State exactly how many rounds are included and how additional requests are billed.

slots.author: Studio Solenne
slots.body: Pick one boundary to enforce this week. Your future self—and your best clients—will thank you for it.
